To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) TIMPs are up‐regulated in healing wounds of normal skin, but not of aged skin; (b) mRNA expression of TIMPs is greater in the wounds of young skin than in those of aged skin; and (c) mRNA levels for TIMPs are significantly lower in aged skin compared with normal young skin.
